strap
音标：英 /stræp/  美 /stræp/
n. 带， 皮带
vt. 捆扎
短语：leather strap — 皮带，皮表带
短语：shoulder strap — 肩章；保护肩部的衬垫
短语：wrist strap — 防静电手环，腕带
短语：steel strap — 护顶钢板；钢板
例句：a bra strap
胸罩肩带
例句：The strap of my bag is broken.

conviction
音标：英 /kən'vɪkʃn/  美 /kən'vɪkʃən/
n. 深信， 确信
例句：It was a reasonable explanation, but his voice lacked conviction .
这解释合情合理，只是他的语气不坚定。
例句：It took her so much effort to speak that what she said carried great conviction (= showed she felt sure of what she said ) .
她费了很大的劲在说，因此说出来的话显得很确定。
